stem: What happens next in this passage after “The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.”?
options: There is also a list of teachers who open classrooms during lunch for quiet study.
Leo learned that seeing the same story many times does not always make it true.
They learned that she arrived at school earlier than most teachers and knew which classrooms were always neat or messy.
The school learned that saying goodbye does not always mean forgetting.
